title: Beyond Passing Tests: A Systematic Review and Controlled Re-evaluation of Techniques for Improving the Quality of LLM-Generated Code
title_zh: 超越通过测试：提升大语言模型生成代码质量技术的系统性综述与受控再评估

paragraphs.en: 系统综述与受控再评估发现多数代码质量提升技术未超越预算匹配的best-of-n采样基线。 Large language models pass most functional-correctness benchmarks, but passing tests says little about whether their code is readable, efficient or secure. Many techniques claim to improve these qualities, yet their evidence is scattered, usually covers one quality dimension and is rarely compared at an equal compute budget. We contribute a systematic review and a controlled re-evaluation. A systematic literature review of 628 primary studies (July 2021 to October 2026), with disclosed, author-reviewed LLM assistance, organizes the techniques by stage, signal source and quality target. Most studies measure only the dimension they target, gains often come with unchanged or unreported correctness, single automated quality signals are gamed, and compute, variance and contamination are rarely reported. A controlled re-evaluation runs ten techniques on four models at matched budgets on correctness, maintainability, efficiency and security benchmarks, extends it to thirteen current models and repository-level tasks, and compares 66 highlighted techniques head-to-head on Gemma 4 31B. At one call, quality prompting raises analyzer issue counts and leaves complexity and judge scores almost unchanged. At matched budgets, best-of-n sampling with an analyzer-weighted ranker matches or beats prompting, planning, self-refinement, a reviewer agent and retrieval on measures the ranker does not optimize, while an analyzer feedback loop and fine-tuning beat it only on analyzer issue counts. Large correctness losses on HumanEval+, a likely contaminated benchmark near its ceiling, do not appear on contests held after the models' training cutoffs. In the head-to-head, 1 of 66 techniques beats best-of-n on its primary target beyond the 95% interval, a rate consistent with chance. Gains should be reported against a budget-matched sampling baseline and on measures independent of the technique's own signal.
paragraphs.zh: 系统综述与受控再评估发现多数代码质量提升技术未超越预算匹配的best-of-n采样基线。 大语言模型通过了大多数功能正确性基准测试，但通过测试并不能说明其代码是否可读、高效或安全。 许多技术声称能改善这些质量属性，但相关证据零散，通常只覆盖单一质量维度，且很少在相同计算预算下进行比较。 我们贡献了一项系统综述和一项受控再评估。 一项针对628篇原始研究（2021年7月至2026年10月）的系统文献综述，公开并经作者审核了大语言模型的辅助使用，按阶段、信号来源和质量目标对相关技术进行了归类整理。 多数研究只测量其针对的维度，性能提升往往伴随着正确性不变或未报告，单一的自动化质量信号容易被投机取巧，而计算量、方差和数据污染很少被报告。 一项受控再评估在四个模型上以匹配预算运行十种技术，覆盖正确性、可维护性、效率和安全性基准，并将其扩展到十三个当前模型和仓库级任务，还在 Gemma 4 31B 上对66种重点技术进行了正面对比。 在单次调用下，质量提示法提高了分析器的问题计数，但复杂度和评审分数几乎不变。 在匹配预算下，使用分析器加权排序器的best-of-n采样在排序器未优化的指标上持平或优于提示法、规划、自我改进、评审智能体和检索，而分析器反馈循环和微调仅在分析器问题计数上胜过它。 在 HumanEval+（一个可能已被污染且接近天花板的基准）上出现的大幅正确性下降，并未出现在模型训练截止日期之后举办的竞赛题上。 在正面对比中，66种技术中仅有1种在其主要目标上以超出95%区间的幅度胜过best-of-n，这一比例与随机概率相符。 性能提升应当对照预算匹配的采样基线进行报告，并在独立于该技术自身信号的指标上进行测量。
